question: In which of the following oceans is Torres Strait located?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Pacific Ocean**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Torres Strait**

 
 
• Torres Strait, the passage between the Coral Sea in the east and the Arafura Sea in the **western Pacific Ocean**.
 
• It is named after the Spanish navigator** Luis Vaz de Torres**, who passed through the strait in 1606.
 
• An important international sea route, it is very shallow and the maze of rocks and islands can make it dangerous to navigate.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
